summary: The checked operational replay family constructs same-body staged transcript and authentication records with actual gamma and alpha0 values, but that staged verifier does not execute the compact relation terminal. Therefore its success cannot currently produce the RecoveredMiddleFork, selected semantic residual, or checked-payment premises consumed by the existing 29-by-4 recovery chain.

produces: 116 pointwise SuccessfulReplay witnesses from a supplied complete matrix
same-body equality for each selected cell
actual decoded gamma and alpha0 labels
does_not_produce: a complete matrix from a bounded number of attempts
common pre-gamma history across all cells

produces: same-body roots used by the selected authentication suffix
available_producers.reason: The module explicitly defines a guard-relaxed source root and states that the selected semantic terminal is not executed.

produces: successful wholeStagedScript return on the replay-returned body
available_producers.reason: selectedCheck accepts every `.ok record` returned by wholeStagedScript; it does not check the compact terminal equation.

produces: a computed 29-by-4 interpolation tuple in the fixed family
requires_unproduced: for every one of 29 gamma nodes and four alpha nodes, RecoveredMiddleFork for the same Execution and family

produces: transfer transition, membership, nullifier, anchor and raw-input decoder facts, or an explicit copy collision
requires_unproduced: RowsVanish for the recovered semantic table
PoseidonChecks for the recovered semantic table
CopyConditions for the recovered tuple helper

missing_bridges_in_order.needed: Extend the same-body dynamic selected source execution through the actual compact relation terminal and construct its accepted result from that run.
missing_bridges_in_order.must_not_be_replaced_by: A caller-supplied terminal-success or RecoveredHigh premise.

missing_bridges_in_order.needed: For each legally restored accepted continuation, derive RecoveredMiddleFork or an explicitly bounded alternative, while proving one common fixed execution/family and causal prefix across the matrix.
missing_bridges_in_order.must_not_be_replaced_by: Assuming every checked transcript record is usable or testing the noncomputable RecoveredHigh predicate.

missing_bridges_in_order.needed: Prove that the bounded permitted-access replay collector obtains all 116 distinct usable cells, or charge every rejection, duplicate, authentication failure and resource exhaustion event.
missing_bridges_in_order.must_not_be_replaced_by: Supplying Progress or CurrentComplete to the endpoint.

missing_bridges_in_order.needed: Connect accepted semantic-terminal execution on the recovered tuple to RowsVanish, PoseidonChecks, CopyConditions and the source comparisons, with repair/collision alternatives retained.

Refine the deterministic Lean payment facts to the literal recovered_witness.rs decode and extract_checked validator on the same public/context/transition inputs, within declared access and resource limits.
missing_bridges_in_order.must_not_be_replaced_by: Assuming decoder success, a valid witness, or extract_checked returning Ok.

rationale_for_no_lean_bridge: Every apparent bridge from operational staged success to the existing recovery consumers would need at least one of relation-terminal acceptance, RecoveredMiddleFork, collector Progress, selected residual enforcement, or checked-validator success as a new premise. None is produced by the current source execution. Adding such a theorem would only rename an open obligation and would not advance soundness.
